title: 38-Day Dry Cargo Time Charter
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.MSC.MSC HQS.MSCHQ NORFOLK
description_text: Action Code: Pre-solicitation Date: 18 May 2026 Year: Fiscal Year 2026 Contracting Office Zip Code: 23511 Product or Service Code: V124- Transportation, Travel, & Relocation Services Contracting Office Address: 471 East C Street, Naval Station Norfolk, Norfolk, VA 23511 Subject: 38-day Dry Cargo Time Charter Proposed Solicitation Number: N3220526R6090 Closing Response Date: Tuesday, 26 May 2026 Contract Point of Contact or Contract Specialist: Brandon Page at brandon.a.page.mil@us.navy.mil or 564-226-1239 Contract Award and Solicitation Number: TBD Contract Award Dollar Amount: TBD Contract Line Item Number: N/A Contract Award Date: TBA Contractor: TBD Description: This requirement is for one U.S. or foreign flag, self-sustaining vessel capable of carrying a minimum of 600 TEUs while satisfying all applicable regulatory HAZMAT compatibility and segregation requirements. Place of Contract Performance: The place/range of delivery is Apra Harbor, Guam (NMI); and the place/range of redelivery is Military Ocean Terminal Concord, CA (USA). The layday commences 23 June and cancels 07 July 2026 and the charter period is about 38 days. Set-aside Status: Total Small Business Set-Aside. The decision to release this procurement as Total-Small Business Set-Aside is based on responses received from a recent, sources sought notice for this service. All responsible sources may submit a proposal, which shall be considered by the agency. The Small Business Administrations Procurement Center Representative concurred with this decision.
